stage.value: account setup — SMS consent after switching

job.value: Decide whether to turn on SMS notifications

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The title 'Stay reachable by SMS' with 'Turn on SMS' makes the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Turn on SMS' is dominant, with 'Not now' as a text button.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Turn on SMS' and 'Not now' say what each does.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Terms are plain ('account checks or urgent buyer activity'); 'Professional seller' is their new status.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Turning SMS on or off is a decision they can make, and 'You can change this anytime in Settings > Notifications' lowers the stakes.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only the consent ask and a reassurance line are shown.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Asking for SMS right after the switch fits the moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The 4-line paragraph explaining why is the main content above the fold, though the button label alone is enough to act.
